task: Locate the latest research about gravitational waves that were uploaded to ArXiv this week and provide a brief summary of one article's main findings.
answer: Located the latest gravitational-wave research uploaded to arXiv this week via Advanced Search (query 'gravitational waves', submitted 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25, sorted by Announcement date newest first; 80 results). One of the latest articles: 'Formation and Detectability of PSR J0653+0443-like Extremely Eccentric Binary Neutron Stars in the Milky Way' by Zhiwei Chen, Jihui Zhang, Youjun Lu (https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31583, submitted 22 October 2026). Main findings: The FAST Galactic Plane Pulsar Snapshot (GPPS) survey recently discovered PSR J0653+0443, a binary neutron star system with the highest known orbital eccentricity (e≈0.992) among Galactic BNSs. The authors performed compact binary population synthesis calculations with self-consistent neutron star spin evolution to model the extremely eccentric BNS population detectable by the FAST GPPS survey, explicitly incorporating observational selection effects, to probe the formation and evolution channels of such systems (relevant to gravitational-wave sources).
